contract: An abort marker hides that epoch's data. A later committed epoch of the same producer id remains visible.
An incomplete transaction holds the last stable offset at its first record, so that record is not visible.
Repeating a marker returns the original offset. The opposite marker conflicts and does not replace it.
Two read_committed scans after reopen return the same ids.
limits: This is not a Fetch response and it does not write Kafka control batches.
Transactional offset commits stay on KL11-26.
The journal format is the local PLTXNM01 record.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
